lesson.summary: Nothing to act on: PR #591 only removed comments from merge-group.yml, and run 45054178991 never reached the changed "Keep the result" step, because its group needed no test and the test job was skipped.
lesson.detail: In `factory/workflows/merge-group.yml`, pull request #591 deleted three comments and changed no behaviour. It removed the trailing comment on `overwrite: true` in the test job's "Keep the result" upload step, and the comments above the time-limit step and the retro step in the merge job. Run 45054178991 was started by workflow_dispatch. Its begin job found that the group needed no test and kept the result itself, so the test job, which holds "Keep the result", was skipped. The merge job then succeeded. The changed step never ran, but the change was comment-only, so it carries no risk. Adam's assumptions about Neon and Vercel concern the project templates, not this workflow.
